Announcements

Temporary Suspension of the publication requests

January 16, 2026

Dear colleagues
We would like to inform you that the Editorial Board of the Jordanian Journal of Educational Sciences has decided to suspend the reception of research papers for one month, from January 16, 2026, to February 16, 2026. This decision comes due to the large number of research papers recently received by the journal, as well as to ensure the completion of the current activities of the journal.
With sincere appreciation and respect.

Professor Dr. Fawwaz Ayoub Momani
Editor-in-Chief of the Jordanian Journal of Educational Sciences
